normalized.description: Engagement of the international consultancy has the following main objectives: 1. Preparation of Participatory and Integrated Land use plans (PILUP) in four critical landscape areas in the selected three regions. 2. Provide training on Participatory and integrated land use planning principles, procedures and instruments, GIS, and gender transformative approaches. The consultancy services mainly include, defining working methodology, data collection and analysis, land use plan proposal and implementation strategies preparation with associated land use plans at appropriate scale in the Benishangul-Gumuz, Central Ethiopia and Sidama regions of Ethiopia.
